# STORAGE_CLASS

A StorageClass a PVC can name, and whether it is the cluster's default.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `storageClass`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.storageClass`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

| className | string |
| isDefault | bool |
